page.overview:
Who is Banji?

Banji is a resident and worker of the , where they will greet travelers as they come by. During the day, they do several chores for the stable with , such as tending to the , cataloging the cargo, and caring for the horses. They also believe the White Goats at the stable are the cutest in .

When it rains, Banji will run inside and comment that it is raining nonstop.

Banji offers directions to travelers who pass through the stable. If asked about the east, Banji speaks about . If Link has not yet completed the trials on , they will explain that it is an area with constant thunderstorms. They consider the storm clouds to be a sign from to stay away. If Link has completed the trials, they will tell him that the thunderstorms recently disappeared after many years. Banji tells Link that they are thinking of taking the horses from the stable on a trip to the bog soon, since the storms have cleared.

When asked about the south, they tell Link about the and , claiming there is a legend about a "lord" over all living things as well as a who watches over the , which their aunt told them stories about.
